claim_scores.rationale: Enables DSPy memory cache with `configure_cache(...)` and uses `dspy.LM(..., cache=True)`, which exercises the cached LM path described in the evidence.
Patches `litellm.completion` and the fake inspects `api_base`/`api_key`, returning endpoint-specific text via `FakeResp`.
Makes two LM calls with the same prompt and changes only `api_base` and `api_key`, matching the ignored cache-key fields in the evidence.
Asserts the second result equals the first endpoint's response, showing reuse of the cached first answer rather than a fresh second-endpoint answer.
Asserts `call_bases == ["http://cluster-a/v1"]`, proving only the first outbound backend call occurred.
Checks `len(dspy.cache.memory_cache) == 1`, a valid extra confirmation that only one cache entry was created.
